paragraphs: R’ Yose the Tall, a disciple of Rabbi.

Hyman cites [Bereshit Rabbah 97:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.97.3) and [Shemot Rabbah 2:5](https://www.sefaria.org/Shemot_Rabbah.2.5): wherever R’ Yose the Tall was seen, people knew that Rabbi was there too, for he was Rabbi’s attendant. Hyman reports that Radal suggests he may be Yosef Chafni in [Ketubot 103a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.103a.31). Rabbi said of Yosef and Pinchas Efrati: “They served me in my lifetime; they will serve me in my death.” They died before Rabbi. [Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Ketubot.12.3.3) calls him Yosa Chafni.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The two linked midrashim use Yose’s presence as a sign that Rabbi is nearby. [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1930&lang=en) cites both parallels.

In his glosses, Radal explains that Yose [walked ahead of Rabbi](https://www.sefaria.org/Chidushei_HaRadal_on_Shemot_Rabbah.2.5.2) and suggests that he [may be Yosef Chafni](https://www.sefaria.org/Chidushei_HaRadal_on_Bereshit_Rabbah.97.3.4).

[Hyman’s notice begins on p. 737](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/60/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._II._1910.pdf#page=320) and continues on [p. 738](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/60/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._II._1910.pdf#page=321) with Pinchas Efrati. The Bavli, [Hyman’s account on p. 598](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/60/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._II._1910.pdf#page=181), and [Heilprin’s Yosef Chafni entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2001&lang=en) give Shimon. The linked Yerushalmi names Yosa Chafni and Yosef Efrati.
